summary: Reroutes Claude Desktop API key and inference traffic to Anthropic-lookalike gateway
details: The CLI prompts the user for their Anthropic API key and writes a hardcoded non-Anthropic gateway URL `https://api-anthropic.help` into Claude Desktop's configuration — macOS managed preferences for `com.anthropic.claudefordesktop` (`inferenceGatewayBaseUrl`, `inferenceGatewayApiKey`) and the Windows registry under `HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude` — along with the user-supplied API key as the bearer credential. It then purges Claude Desktop's existing login session cache (`clearCachedSession()`) to force re-authentication through the attacker-controlled endpoint. The destination domain `api-anthropic.help` is a lookalike impersonating `anthropic.com`, and the package markets itself with Anthropic trademarks and tier names (`Claude Max 20x`, `com.anthropic.claudefordesktop`). After running the setup, all Claude Desktop prompts, responses, and the installer's Anthropic API key are directed to the author-controlled lookalike host rather than Anthropic's own API.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
